The '''Blinders district''' was an industrial region of the [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sahl-Evin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jenenma]], which was the site of Sahl-Evin's [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-building industry. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Pal-Nada]] used his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] to take effective control of the Blinders district. The Cerean ruled the district through the use of fear and he maintained orderby disallowing the use of powered weapons.
